name: @w6w-apps/enrichlayer
description: Enrich people, companies, jobs and schools: profile lookups, dataset search, work and personal emails and phones, reverse email and phone lookup, and the credit balance.

w6w.longDescription:
Enrich Layer is a B2B data enrichment API with structured data on over a billion people, tens of millions of companies and hundreds of millions of jobs. This app covers the v2 API: get a person, company, school or job profile from a public profile URL; look people up by name and company, by role at a company, or by email or phone number; search the people and company datasets by criteria; list a company's employees or a school's students; count employees and open jobs; find personal emails and phone numbers, request a work email, and check whether an address is disposable.

Every call spends credits, and each action's description states its cost (profile lookups 1 to 3 credits; employee and student listings per result; search 3 credits per result). The credit balance, the profile pictures and the ID and disposable-email lookups are free.

Health checks verify the API key, whether the API is answering, Enrich Layer's per-endpoint status page, and the remaining credit balance.
